SELECT date_trunc('month', f.sale_date) AS m, p.vat_class, f.vat_rate,
       count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS n_ids, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS n_rl,
       sum(f.net_amount) AS net, sum(f.gross_amount) AS gross,
       round(sum(f.gross_amount)/sum(f.net_amount),4) AS implied,
       sum(CASE WHEN s.store_id<900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_phys, min(f.etl_loaded_at) AS min_etl, max(f.etl_loaded_at) AS max_etl
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
  AND s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

WITH f AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', f.sale_date) AS m, sum(f.net_amount) AS net, sum(f.gross_amount) AS gross, count(*) AS n,
         count(DISTINCT s.store_id) AS stores, count(DISTINCT f.sale_date) AS days
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY 1),
r AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', business_date) AS m, sum(net_sales_before_returns) AS ctrl_net, count(DISTINCT store_id) AS stores, count(DISTINCT business_date) AS days
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND store_id<900 GROUP BY 1),
a AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', f.sale_date) AS m, count(*) AS n_all, sum(CASE WHEN s.store_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_store,
         sum(CASE WHEN p.product_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_prod
  FROM fact_sales_line f LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key LEFT JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT f.m, f.net, r.ctrl_net, f.net-r.ctrl_net AS diff, f.gross, f.n, f.stores, r.stores AS ctrl_stores, f.days, r.days AS ctrl_days, a.n_all, a.no_store, a.no_prod
FROM f JOIN r USING (m) JOIN a USING (m) ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('month', f.sale_date) AS m,
  CASE WHEN s.store_id=999 THEN 'training999' WHEN s.store_id=900 THEN 'web900' WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN 'ZZtest_in_stores' ELSE 'stores' END AS grp,
  count(*) AS n, sum(f.gross_amount) AS gross, sum(f.net_amount) AS net,
  sum(CASE WHEN abs(f.gross_amount - round(f.net_amount*(1+f.vat_rate),2))>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_vat_lines,
  sum(CASE WHEN f.net_amount<=0 OR f.quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonpos,
  sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS staff
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT strftime(date_trunc('month', f.sale_date), '%Y-%m') AS month,
       SUM(f.gross_amount) AS store_sales_incl_vat_before_returns
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE s.store_id < 900
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
